_comment: リスニング「悪い ニュースの 報告」の 表紙（cover）。**設定画（sheet.webp）だけを 参照入力に 渡す** — 参考写真は 設定画を 作る ときだけ（富田さんで 写真の 無精髭を 拾った 実例。docs/skills/codex_image_generation.md §6.7）。服装と 顔は 人物カード content/characters/fujiki.json の looks が 正——20代後半・紺の ジャケットに 白い Tシャツ・**ほうれい線を 描かない**（2026-08-14 の 指定）。**この 台帳は 文字を 焼く**ので noText は hourensou_zukai.json と 同文（漢字の 上に 45% の 大きさで ふりがな）。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME. The label sits on a soft cream panel with a rounded border, large and easy to read in one pass.
noText: Japanese lettering — read this part carefully. The picture contains ONLY the Japanese words listed in the scene above, and no other writing at all. Print each word LARGE and horizontally in a rounded gothic Japanese font, with generous space around it. Directly above every kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height, so that the kanji and the furigana both stay sharp and easy to read at a glance. Words written only in hiragana or katakana take no furigana. Spell every character exactly as given. No other letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots.

scenes.title: リスニング「悪い ニュースの 報告」の 表紙 — 聞く 相手は 藤木取締役
scenes.where: content/listening/houkoku_listening.json の cover（画面: /houkoku の リスニング、題の すぐ 下）
scenes.scene: Fujiki the director, ALONE — he is the only person in the picture. Taken from the attached character sheet: a Japanese man in his late twenties, very short cropped black hair, smooth flat skin with absolutely no nasolabial folds and no cheek or forehead lines, thick eyebrows, big bright dark brown eyes, navy blazer worn open over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, no tie, no glasses. He stands beside his desk in a bright contemporary Japanese software office, turned toward the viewer, seen from the waist up and filling the left two thirds of the frame — the camera is where the young employee who has come to talk to him would stand. His expression is warm and attentive with a calm closed-mouth smile and eyebrows lifted a little in interest: he is ready to LISTEN, not to scold. One hand is open at chest height in a welcoming 'please, go ahead' gesture, the other rests lightly on the back of his office chair; exactly five fingers on each hand, no tangled or merged fingers. Behind him a big window with soft daylight, a green plant, a mug and a closed laptop on the tidy desk; every screen, paper and whiteboard is completely blank. In the upper right, at his shoulder height, one soft cream panel with a rounded border carries the two Japanese words given below, stacked on two lines.
